query: within-run and across-run adaptation agent training
LLM agent training environment evolves with policy
text:
1. **GenEnv: Difficulty-Aligned Co-Evolution Between LLM Agents and Environment Simulators** — Closest match. An environment policy continually generates tasks calibrated to the evolving agent policy. People: Jiacheng Guo, Ling Yang, Jiahao Qiu, Ke Shen, Mengdi Wang (Princeton); Peter Chen (Columbia); Qixin Xiao and Xinzhe Juan (Michigan); Yinjie Wang (Chicago). [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.19682)

2. **CoEvolve: Training LLM Agents via Agent-Data Mutual Evolution** — Uses policy failures and uncertainty to synthesize new tasks, jointly evolving the agent and training distribution. People: Shidong Yang, Ziyu Ma, Tongwen Huang, Yiming Hu, Yong Wang, Xiangxiang Chu (AMAP, Alibaba Group). [ACL Anthology](https://aclanthology.org/2026.acl-long.1055/)

3. **From Trainee to Trainer: LLM-Designed Training Environment for RL with Multi-Agent Reasoning** — The current policy diagnoses its failures and redesigns the next-stage RL environment. People: Chao Chen, Chengzu Li, Zhiwei Li, Yinhong Liu, Zhijiang Guo (LARK/HKUST Guangzhou, University of Cambridge, and HKUST). [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17682)

4. **WebRL: Training LLM Web Agents via Self-Evolving Online Curriculum Reinforcement Learning** — An earlier closely related approach that creates new web tasks from failed attempts as the policy changes. People: Zehan Qi, Xiao Liu, Iat Long Iong, Hanyu Lai, Xueqiao Sun, Jiadai Sun, Xinyue Yang, Yu Yang, Shuntian Yao, Wei Xu, Jie Tang, Yuxiao Dong (Tsinghua University, Zhipu AI, and Shanghai Qi Zhi Institute). [OpenReview](https://openreview.net/forum?id=oVKEAFjEqv)
